description: This file defines the AuthService class which provides methods for managing user authentication state locally using SharedPreferences. It includes functions to check onboarding status, login, logout, and retrieve current user information.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides local authentication state management methods such as onboarding completion, login, logout, and retrieving current user info.

methods.name: isOnboarded
methods.description: Checks whether the onboarding process has been completed by retrieving a boolean flag from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: completeOnboarding
methods.description: Marks onboarding as complete by setting a boolean flag in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Determines if a user is logged in by checking if the username stored in SharedPreferences is non-empty.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Stores the provided username in SharedPreferences to log in the user.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Removes the username from SharedPreferences, effectively logging the user out.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current username from SharedPreferences, if any.
